title: Training Notes: Investor and Second-Home Occupancy and the Home Purchase Agreement Additional Deposit Rate
content:
**Q. Does the buyer's intended use of the home affect the additional deposit rate on a Home Purchase Agreement?**
Yes. The rate is uplifted by how the buyer will occupy the home, as stated on the buyer's converted Homesite Reservation:

- where the occupancy intent is **investor**, **1.0 percentage point** is added;
- where it is **second home**, **0.5 percentage points** are added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

**Q. Where is the occupancy intent read?**
On the converted Homesite Reservation, as the buyer stated it there.

**Q. What if the buyer has no converted Homesite Reservation?**
Then there is no stated occupancy intent of investor or second home to read, and nothing is added.

**Check yourself (hypothetical buyers).**

| Occupancy intent on the converted Homesite Reservation | Points added |
|---|---|
| Investor | 1.0 |
| Second home | 0.5 |
| Any other stated intent | Nothing |
| No converted Homesite Reservation | Nothing |

*Worked case.* A collection rate of 3.0 percent with an investor occupancy intent becomes 4.0 percent from this uplift.
